intents.definition: Customer inquiring about late deliveries, package tracking updates, carrier delays, or estimated arrival times.
examples: My package was supposed to arrive yesterday and tracking has not updated.
Where is my Prime order #112-892341? It's 2 days late.
Tracking status says in transit for 4 days with no new scan.
Expected delivery was 8 PM tonight but carrier still hasn't delivered.
intents.why_it_matters: Highest volume inquiry. Timely tracking reassurance and courier buffer guidance directly prevent repetitive contact and customer frustration.

escalation_policy.auto_handle_criteria: Standard transit delays within normal courier buffer window, requesting general tracking link or how to check delivery status.
escalation_policy.escalate_criteria: Delay exceeds 48 hours past guaranteed delivery date, carrier reported lost, or perishable/urgent medication shipment.

intents.definition: Customer reports order is marked 'Delivered' in tracking or photo proof, but physical parcel cannot be located anywhere.
examples: Tracking says delivered to front porch 20 mins ago, but nothing is outside my door.
Delivery photo shows a completely different apartment building door.
Driver marked package as handed to resident but no one was home.
I checked around the garage and with neighbors, the package is missing.
intents.why_it_matters: High emotional distress and immediate financial risk. Requires prompt check of safe drop locations followed by courier investigation.

escalation_policy.auto_handle_criteria: Package marked delivered within past 1-2 hours (requesting customer to check safe spots/neighbors as drivers sometimes mark early).
escalation_policy.escalate_criteria: Customer already checked all safe locations, delivery photo confirms wrong address, or 24 hours have passed since delivery scan.

intents.definition: Customer inquiries regarding return window rules, generating return shipping labels/drop-off QR codes, or status of pending refunds for returned items.
examples: I dropped off my return at UPS 5 days ago, when will my refund hit my card?
How do I generate a return label for an unopened item?
My return was received at the fulfillment center last week but refund still pending.
Can I return an item after the 30-day holiday return window?
intents.why_it_matters: Direct financial impact. Customers need clarity on standard 3-5 business day banking processing times or return authorization steps.

escalation_policy.auto_handle_criteria: Explaining standard return steps, drop-off locations (UPS/Kohl's/Whole Foods), or standard refund timelines.
escalation_policy.escalate_criteria: Refund has not posted after 7+ business days from confirmed warehouse delivery, or return label generation fails repeatedly.

intents.definition: Customer received an item that is broken, defective, expired, or completely different from the purchased product listing.
examples: The blender arrived with shattered glass and oil leaking everywhere.
I ordered men's size 11 running shoes but received women's size 6 sandals.
The box was crushed in transit and the internal product is broken.
Received an empty manufacturer box with the seal cut open.
intents.why_it_matters: Fulfillment failure eroding brand trust. Requires replacement authorization or immediate return exemption for damaged goods.

escalation_policy.auto_handle_criteria: Directing customer to the Online Returns Center replacement option for routine wrong sizes or mildly defective items.
escalation_policy.escalate_criteria: High-value item broken, hazardous chemical leak, missing contents inside empty sealed parcel, or repeat replacement defect.

intents.definition: Questions regarding unauthorized membership renewals, subscription fee disputes, promotional discount code errors, or membership cancellation.
examples: I was charged $139 for an annual Prime membership that I never authorized.
How do I cancel my Prime student free trial so I don't get billed?
My gift card balance was not applied towards my checkout total.
Why did my monthly subscription fee increase without notification?
intents.why_it_matters: Disputed charges create high churn and chargeback risks. Requires clear self-service cancellation guidance or billing specialist review.

escalation_policy.auto_handle_criteria: Guiding user to 'Manage Prime Membership' page or explaining prorated trial cancellation policy.
escalation_policy.escalate_criteria: Disputed unknown card charge, recurring unauthorized billing, or promo code failure on completed transaction requiring manual credit.

intents.definition: Technical issues concerning Kindle e-readers, Prime Video playback errors, Fire TV app crashes, Alexa device connectivity, or Music streaming.
examples: Prime Video gives error code 5004 whenever I try to stream on my smart TV.
My Kindle Paperwhite won't sync newly purchased books over Wi-Fi.
Alexa keeps disconnecting from my home Wi-Fi network every morning.
Fire Stick remote stopped pairing even after replacing batteries.
intents.why_it_matters: Customer is blocked from consuming digital media they paid for. Fast troubleshooting steps can resolve high percentage of device issues.

escalation_policy.auto_handle_criteria: Standard device restart, cache clearing, app reinstallation, or Wi-Fi reconnect steps.
escalation_policy.escalate_criteria: Hardware failure, persistent DRM/licensing authentication error, or defective device still under hardware warranty.

intents.definition: Inability to sign in, two-factor authentication (2FA/OTP) failures, unauthorized account changes, phishing notices, or compromised accounts.
examples: I received a login alert from Russia and someone changed my shipping address!
I'm not receiving the two-step verification SMS code to log into my account.
My account has been locked due to unusual activity and I cannot reach anyone.
Someone placed 3 large gift card orders on my account without my knowledge.
intents.why_it_matters: Critical customer security and liability risk. Strict protocols apply regarding personal data protection.

escalation_policy.auto_handle_criteria: General guidance on standard password reset self-service links if no suspicious activity reported.
escalation_policy.escalate_criteria: MANDATORY ESCALATION: Any mention of compromised account, unauthorized orders, fraudulent password change, or locked account.

intents.definition: General inquiries regarding shipping coverage, warranty terms, gift card redemption rules, packaging options, or restock dates.
examples: Do you ship electronics and books to APO/FPO military addresses?
Can I combine two different Amazon gift cards on one checkout?
Does this renewed iPad include the original Apple warranty?
Is gift wrapping available for oversized furniture items?
intents.why_it_matters: Pre-purchase or general informational questions that can be reliably answered from public knowledge bases without human agent cost.

escalation_policy.auto_handle_criteria: Standard public policy explanations (shipping destinations, gift card terms, packaging).
escalation_policy.escalate_criteria: Complex cross-border customs restrictions, legal disputes, or requests requiring private seller contracts.
